classes.name: BRepToIGES_BREntity
classes.summary: provides methods to transfer BRep entity from CASCADE to IGES.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes the field of the tool BREntity with default creating values.

instanceMethods.name: SetModel
instanceMethods.comment: Set the value of "TheModel".

instanceMethods.name: GetModel
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of "TheModel".

instanceMethods.name: GetUnit
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the UnitFlag of the header of the model in meters.

instanceMethods.name: SetTransferProcess
instanceMethods.comment: Set the value of "TheMap".

instanceMethods.name: GetTransferProcess
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of "TheMap".

instanceMethods.name: TransferShape
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the result of the transfert of any Shape If the transfer has failed, this member return a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: AddFail
instanceMethods.comment: Records a new Fail message.

instanceMethods.name: AddFail
instanceMethods.comment: Records a new Fail message.

instanceMethods.name: AddWarning
instanceMethods.comment: Records a new Warning message.

instanceMethods.name: AddWarning
instanceMethods.comment: Records a new Warning message.

instanceMethods.name: HasShapeResult
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if start was already treated and has a result in "TheMap" else returns False.

instanceMethods.name: HasShapeResult
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if start was already treated and has a result in "TheMap" else returns False.

instanceMethods.name: GetShapeResult
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the result of the transfer of the Shape "start" contained in "TheMap". (if HasShapeResult is True).

instanceMethods.name: GetShapeResult
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the result of the transfer of the Transient "start" contained in "TheMap". (if HasShapeResult is True).

instanceMethods.name: SetShapeResult
instanceMethods.comment: set in "TheMap" the result of the transfer of the Shape "start".

instanceMethods.name: SetShapeResult
instanceMethods.comment: set in "TheMap" the result of the transfer of the Transient "start".

instanceMethods.name: GetConvertSurfaceMode
instanceMethods.comment: Returns mode for conversion of surfaces (value of parameter write.convertsurface.mode).

instanceMethods.name: GetPCurveMode
instanceMethods.comment: Returns mode for writing pcurves (value of parameter write.surfacecurve.mode).

classes.name: BRepToIGES_BRShell
classes.summary: This class implements the transfer of Shape Entities from Geom To IGES. These can be: . Vertex . Edge . Wire.

instanceMethods.name: TransferShell
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer an Shape entity from `TopoDS` to IGES This entity must be a Face or a Shell. If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferShell
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer an Shell entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.

instanceMethods.name: TransferFace
instanceMethods.comment: Transfer a Face entity from `TopoDS` to IGES If this Entity could not be converted, this member returns a NullEntity.
